subject: Request: trial credit bridge due to procurement delay
messages:
From: Jen Park <jen.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Peter Liu <peter.liu@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial extension request — procurement delay

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Acme Health is excited to pilot Redwood for clinical-notes summarization. Procurement is moving but slower than we expected: legal is finalizing the PO and we don’t have an internal signature yet.

We are currently in your 14-day trial and are expecting to hit our usage cap before the PO clears. Would Redwood be able to provide a 30-day trial extension or temporary credits to cover the pilot until procurement completes? If you need a PO number or formal SOW to move forward, I can escalate on our side.

Appreciate any flexibility — we really want to start integrations next week if possible.

Best,
Jen Park
Director of Clinical Innovation
Acme Health

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jen Park <jen.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — procurement delay

Hi Jen — thanks for the note and for the fast follow after the demo. Really glad the team is keen.

Short answer: yes, we can help bridge the gap. I want to confirm a couple quick details so we provide the right support:
- Current trial end date (I have 2026-03-08)
- High-level expected PO date from Acme Health
- Any internal spend cap we should be aware of for the temporary credit

Neha (cc’d) is our sales operations lead — she’ll help with credit mechanics. Jordan is the sales manager and will review the promotional approval. If you can reply with the PO ETA (even an internal target) and confirm the pilot scope, we’ll propose a concrete extension + credit amount.

If it helps, we can provision a 30-day extension + $2,000 of promo credit pending final PO, subject to quick sign-off from my manager. I’ll loop in finance if we go ahead.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0127

Marissa / Jen — looping in procurement ops context. Jen, helpful if you can confirm:
- ETA for internal PO (best estimate)
- Whether Acme needs an SOW or vendor packet for legal review
- Any billing constraints (e.g., must be invoiced to a parent legal entity)

I've attached a quick procurement_timeline.xlsx template that helps us record expected signoff dates; please fill the estimated dates where you can. Once we have an ETA we can set up a 30-day trial extension and provisional promo credit — final amount will be approved by Jordan/Vivek.

Neha Kapoor
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Jen Park <jen.park@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — procurement delay

Thanks for the context. Approve provisional promotional credit up to $2,000 and a 30-day trial extension to bridge procurement, provided Acme confirms PO ETA within two weeks from today.

Request to Neha: please record the promo in the deal notes (deal RW-ACME-2026-03) and mark as contingent on PO confirmation.

Vivek — for awareness, finance signoff would be appreciated but we can treat this as a standard promo for pilot customers. If you want a stricter approval threshold, flag here.

Jordan Blake
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Jen — quick follow to confirm we’ve provisioned the bridge.

What we did:
- 30-day trial extension applied to your pilot account (new end date: 2026-04-07)
- $2,000 promotional credit loaded against usage through HubSpot deal RW-ACME-2026-03; contingent on PO confirmation within two weeks

Next steps for Acme:
- If you can send a PO number or estimated signoff date, we’ll mark the contingency satisfied in our system.
- I’ve attached a short SOW_Draft.pdf with pilot scope + acceptance criteria — if that helps expedite legal, feel free to redline and return.
- We also included a DocuSign link for a one-page commercial appendix if you prefer a fast path.

Jen — let me know if you want a quick 15-min call tomorrow to align on pilot metrics before you ramp usage.

Thanks — excited to get Acme started.
